# Validation Checklist

## Contract

- Canonical domain and alias hosts must resolve consistently.
- Route resolution must remain deterministic for `domain`, `path`, and `lang`.
- Shared payload files must merge before page-level overrides.
- Lifecycle fallback responses must remain professional and predictable.

## Verification

- Test at least one canonical host scenario and one alias host scenario.
- Re-check the affected route and language combination when merge logic changes.
- Update request examples or response docs when runtime behavior changes.
